trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The last healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions and verified service health is restored (error rate dropped to ~0.2%).
3. **Opened incident INC-0002** (SEV2) documenting the failure, the rollback, and that v2.3.1 needs investigation before any redeploy. The on-call engineer has been paged.
